title: Kya kya sitam guzar gaye
body:
Haye Zahra, haye Zahra..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Masjid se ghar mein laut ke, jab aayi sayyeda
Zainab ne maa ka haal jo dekha to ye kaha
<<MINI>>
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, amma bataiye
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
<<DIVIDER>>
Baalo ka rang badla hai, kyu jhuk gayi kamar
<<MINI>>
amma bataiye..
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kyu kar chupaye rakha hai
kya dil mein dard hai kyu chehra zard hai, halat tumhari dekh ke
lagta hai mujhko darr
<<MINI>>
amma bataiye...
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Bus muskurate dekha tha humne tumhe sadaa
batlao kya hua, aankhein hui hai aapki, kyu
aasuo'n se tarr
<<MINI>>
amma bataiye...
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Maine suna hai masjid mein rulwaya aapko
jhutlaya aapko
kya baat dil pe lag gayi, uthta nahi jo sar
<<MINI>>
amma bataiye...
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Dar pe hamare pehle to aate the subh o shaam
karne ko sab salaam
nana ke baad phera hai, ummat ne rukh kidhar
<<MINI>>
amma bataiye...
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baba ka raaj hota to ye ghum na jhelti
ye din na dekhti
haq cheena mere baba ka, ummat ne kyu magar
<<MINI>>
amma bataiye...
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Kya dard hai jo aapko, har dum rulata hai
dil dooba jaata hai kyu roz jaake roti hai, nana ki qabr par
<<MINI>>
amma bataiye...
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ashko ki is rawani ne, zainab ko aye raza
sab kuch bata diya
Zehra khamosh hogayi, jab is sawaal par
<<MINI>>
amma bataiye...
Kya kya sitam guzar gaye, ek din mein aap par
amma bataiye, haye amma bataiye
Haye Zahra, haye Zahra
